convention: Every source/state support label is retained separately from its coefficient. Quotients and observations have their kernels/fibres stated.

maps.domain: Original shell and beta_i in [-e_i,e_i]
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse beta_i=v_qi(u)-e_i; ordered factors retained
maps.metric_and_support: Each original labelled state has unit counting mass
maps.name: Bounded exponent/divisor equivalence

maps.codomain: Ordered rational triple with same p,a,R,c,D
maps.domain: Original (p,a,R,c,u)
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse u=a^2/(RY-pa) in E, pa^2/(RY-pa) in M; numerical triple alone does not replace channel
maps.metric_and_support: Failure remains positive rational with exact reduced return denominator D
maps.name: Positive rational candidate and ordered return

maps.domain: Original divisor u|a^2
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse a=hrs,u=hr^2; quotient kappa or lambda attached; E/M and raw order retained
maps.metric_and_support: No Koide restriction asserted
maps.name: Coprime marking

maps.domain: Original state alpha
maps.formula: Read channel and full bounded exponent
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Projection to two bits has all original states with those bits as fibre; labels remain on full source
maps.metric_and_support: Both support sets overlap on actual original states
maps.name: Overlapping support observation

maps.domain: R^r coefficient vectors
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: All inverse solutions c0+ker A; ker A=ker K
maps.metric_and_support: K=A* A is the actual quotient metric; cross terms retained
maps.name: Mixed synthesis

maps.domain: R^r/ker A with K
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse coefficient class solving Ac=f; full source return also retains (I-P_A)f
maps.metric_and_support: Isometry in K, not a reset Euclidean norm
maps.name: Feature quotient/image isometry

maps.domain: Direct sum of supported coordinate functions
maps.formula: Sum all input coefficients at each original state
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Kernel fibre sums zero; primitive star differences v_i(e_i-e_i0)
maps.metric_and_support: Cancellation preserves support union, including supported zero
maps.name: Overlapping occurrence addition

maps.domain: Actual original multiplier X-1/3
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Records one chosen feature restriction; it does not invert the entire source operator
maps.metric_and_support: Every off-diagonal entry uses the same states; no orthogonality from names
maps.name: Signed localizing pullback

maps.domain: (t,z), first coefficient pivot -a<0
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse t=s+b*z/a; strict theorem excludes zero pivot; actual inertia preserved
maps.metric_and_support: Signed congruence not positive-metric orthogonal projection
maps.name: Signed Schur congruence

maps.domain: Any positive-definite coefficient subspace for J
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Injective on that subspace; bound dimension <=H, not onto all hits in general
maps.metric_and_support: Proof uses failure contributions <=0
maps.name: Positive-subspace injection

maps.codomain: Integer lower bound on original H
maps.domain: Explicit coefficient c and proved hit-pattern cap M(c)>0
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: One-sided bound, not an inverse; pattern cap must be justified independently of hit choices
maps.metric_and_support: Original counting mass, supports and signs unchanged
maps.name: Pattern-normalized count lower bound

maps.domain: F in image of the three hard-shell features
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Verify recovered linear combination at every original state; equivalent K^-1 A*
maps.metric_and_support: K positive definite proved by these independent evaluations
maps.name: Concrete image inverse

maps.domain: B_f x B_b x {E,M}
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: All intervals max(-f_i,beta_i-b_i)<=xi_i<=min(f_i,beta_i+b_i), eta=beta-xi
maps.metric_and_support: n_beta may vary; none of its occurrences suppressed
maps.name: Actual split addition

maps.domain: Original counting l2
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: EU=I; ker E fibre sums zero with star primitives; full fibre Uv+ker E
maps.metric_and_support: U*=E, exact Pythagoras
maps.name: Value duplication and weighted return

maps.domain: Full original support predicate on beta
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Using xi alone changes support and is rejected; target-source state labels persist
maps.metric_and_support: Mixed Gram transport includes inverse fibre weights
maps.name: Support pullback

maps.domain: Original states via retained top-monomial module
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Failed top directions remain; augmentation kills their receiving coefficients
maps.metric_and_support: Supported zero is not external absence; no residue-H0 dimension substitution
maps.name: Boundary receiving comparison

maps.domain: Odd-reciprocal diagonal X and actual A
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: No inverse to compressed form asserted; lost source sector explicit
maps.metric_and_support: Loewner error <=epsilon_j K; all cross terms retained
maps.name: Original filter followed by feature observation

maps.domain: Countable direct sum of actual metric quotients V_p
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Isometry onto its image; orthogonal complement retained
maps.metric_and_support: Uniform norm error <=1/(2^j j! (2j+3)), without a feature-count bound
maps.name: Uniform mixed direct sum

maps.domain: Isometry bar A onto feature subspace
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: R_A*=adjoint; R_A*R_A=bar A*X^2 bar A-C^2; zero iff invariant
maps.metric_and_support: Original relation norm retained, not discarded after quotient
maps.name: Compression multiplication defect

maps.codomain: Correct A*Phi(X)A or separately defined Phi(C)
maps.domain: Original diagonal spectrum and feature compression
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: They need not agree; p37 example records exact discrepancy, not a valid intertwiner
maps.metric_and_support: Correct filter used before compression; compressed spectrum can leave odd reciprocals
maps.name: Functional-calculus order

maps.domain: All original states in four support cells
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Forgets individual states; witness extractor still uses retained full state set
maps.metric_and_support: No products of independent marginals; overlap S_k^11 retained
maps.name: Mixed gcd-moment observation

maps.codomain: A labelled D=1 state and A4 denominators
maps.domain: Positive rational trial plus complete original finite source
maps.formula: Enumerate in retained order and return a hit; theorem guarantees at least one
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Positive trial does not uniquely specify a witness; complete hit fibre serialized
maps.metric_and_support: All 9702 leaves and three actual hits remain; no prime-coverage claim
maps.name: Certificate to arithmetic witness
